title: Temple of Augustus in Ankara
visualBrief: Surviving open temple ruins inside the mapped Ankara archaeological site: two tall broken limestone cella walls, southwest open vestibule, tall genuine rectangular portal with layered jambs/lintel, three small arched window openings in the southeast wall, low rear stone/brick-banded remnants, scattered foundations and broken drums, plus an open modern steel conservation frame. No ancient roof, pediment or complete colonnade is restored. Internal dimensions and remnant/frame inventory are picture-led approximations; the neighboring mosque is independent native context.
